lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, displaying a transition from high-density, small-diameter clusters near the branchial region to lower-density, larger-diameter clusters as they progress posteriorly toward the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a distinct lattice-like structural pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light dorsal edge and a cast shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A black graphical arrow overlay is positioned on the mid-lateral flank pointing to a specific spot cluster; additionally, several commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral and sub-pectoral regions.
